issues.description: download_and_untar.sh warns about missing unzip and bad argv but does not exit, letting failures cascade
issues.detail: When unzip is absent or argc is wrong, the script prints a message and falls through. Under set -euo pipefail this produces opaque errors downstream (realpath on unset $1, mid-extraction unzip failure) instead of clean fail-fast behavior. Add exit 1 after both the missing-tool warning and the usage block.

issues.description: README link to ASR config points to nonexistent ./conf/train/ subdirectory
issues.detail: README references ./conf/train/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml, but the file is at ./conf/train_asr_branchformer_e24_amp.yaml. The link 404s on GitHub. Fix the path to match the actual artifact location.

issues.description: Unquoted command substitutions in download_and_untar.sh break under set -u with spaces in paths
issues.detail: extract_dir=$(realpath $1) and realpath ${2:-$extract_dir} are unquoted. With set -euo pipefail already in effect, paths containing spaces will cause latent crashes. Quote them: realpath "$1" and realpath "${2:-$extract_dir}".

issues.description: Duplicate db.sh added as both a regular file and a symlink at the same path
issues.detail: The diff adds egs2/tal_zh_adult_teach/asr1/db.sh both as a standalone file (TAL_ZH_ADULT_TEACH=downloads) and as a symlink to ../../TEMPLATE/asr1/db.sh. Two entries cannot coexist at one path. Follow the recipe convention: keep the TEMPLATE symlink and edit the global db.sh instead.

issues.description: Hard-coded utterance counts couple the recipe to one snapshot of the dataset
issues.detail: data.sh aborts if wc -l doesn't match magic numbers (22467/3208/6072/29386/38924). Any benign upstream change to the public dataset breaks the recipe with no actionable path. Either downgrade to a warning, or document where the numbers come from so future maintainers can update them.

issues.description: Transcript normalization is an opaque chain of single-character seds with no comment
issues.detail: The pipeline runs six sequential sed processes stripping full-width characters and punctuation with no documentation of why this set and not others (e.g., other full-width digits/letters). Collapse into one sed -e ... -e ... or tr -d invocation and add a one-line comment stating the normalization target.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on a recipe-shaped contribution that is structurally fine (symlinks to TEMPLATE, standard YAML configs) but has sloppy shell hygiene in the two real scripts. The strongest consensus is that download_and_untar.sh fails soft where it should fail hard — missing unzip and bad argv only print warnings, and unquoted realpath calls are latent crashes under set -euo pipefail. The README's config link is broken on all three reviews. Torvalds additionally catches a duplicate db.sh entry (file + symlink at one path) and hard-coded utterance-count assertions that will rot. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK with small, obvious fixes.
